0022600088.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Raptors host the Bulls. Toronto is without Brandon Ingram, who is out following Achilles surgery, and Chucky Hepburn, Collin Murray-Boyles, Immanuel Quickley, Ja'Kobe Walter, Jakob Poeltl, Jamal Shead, Kawhi Leonard, RJ Barrett and Scottie Barnes are all listed as day-to-day, while Chicago's Isaac Okoro, Nic Claxton, Tobe Awaka and Zach Collins are also day-to-day. The Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, most recently beating the Bulls 139-109 in Chicago on March 18, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Toronto a 75% chance to win.
